arguments.summary: Malware (Trojan.GenericKD.48571234) was detected on endpoint 10.0.3.15 via behavioral analysis. The malware performed process injection into svchost.exe and initiated a C2 callback to internal IP 10.0.6.88 on port 8443. Both IPs were previously involved in Nmap SYN scans targeting internal assets. Despite detection, containment actions (firewall block, EPP quarantine, IAM disable) were denied due to policy or approval constraints. Initial sandbox analysis of the payload returned clean, indicating possible evasion or fileless execution.

rule Trojan_GenericKD_48571234_Mem_Evasion {
    meta:
        description = "Detects in-memory code injection pattern associated with Trojan.GenericKD variants"
        author = "SOC Team"
        hash = "920f33ea"
    strings:
        $x1 = { 68 ?? ?? ?? ?? 68 ?? ?? ?? ?? E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 83 C4 08 } // Push API args and call
        $x2 = "kernel32.dll" ascii
        $x3 = "VirtualAllocEx" ascii
    condition:
        all of ($x*) and #x1 < 100KB and #x2 < 100KB and #x3 < 100KB
}
